seal.statement: A running node answers one explicit admin call with typed, bounded, cursor-windowed measurements of the coordinator side of the transaction path: session FIFO wait, operation run time, COMMIT sub-phases, read and write statements, rollback, coordinator-to-participant requests by operation and metadata persistence by purpose. Every catalogued field is measured or named unavailable, each transaction's phases sum to its total with the remainder reported, each sample carries the existing session and transaction identities, and a product-owned collection function returns one typed entry per node. Production scheduling, durable effects and decisions are unchanged.
